GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 531 (25 Feb 46) GD
(SCAPIN - 770)
APO 500
25 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Night Transportation Service. Tokyo.
1. The necessity for adequate rail transportation to enable the Japanese public to get to and from work in the Metropolitan areas has become increasingly apparent. Lack of transportation during the evening hours is a serious detriment to the re-establishment of normal conditions.
2. It is desired that service be maintained on Tokyo Metropolitan street car lines on 24 hour schedule. It is desired that the service originate at downtown terminii on all lines and during the evening and night hours at 2100, 2200, 2300, 2400, 0100, 0230, 0400, 0500, and 0530 hours. This service will be widely publicized by proper display of schedules in all street cars.
3. It is directed that a traffic survey be made to determine adequacy and use of the service provided in accordance with this directive. A report will be submitted on 15 March to include recommendations for any changes deemed necessary.
4. Service directed in paragraph 2 above, will be instituted without delay. A report will be submitted 24 hours in advance of opening of service.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH
Brigadier General, AGD
Adjutant General
